heading.en: The amplifier that does not amplify voltage

hook.en: An *emitter follower* has a voltage gain just below one, yet it is everywhere. It can take a signal from a weak, high-impedance source and drive a heavy load without loading the source.
hook.kn: ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಫಾಲೋವರ್‌ನ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ವರ್ಧನೆ ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಆದರೂ ಅದು ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ದುರ್ಬಲ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧದ ಆಕರದಿಂದ ಸಂಕೇತ ಪಡೆದು ಭಾರೀ ಲೋಡ್ ನಡೆಸಬಲ್ಲದು.

title.en: Draw the emitter follower and explain its working
Show it is voltage-series feedback with β = 1
Calculate its voltage gain and input impedance

say.en: An emitter follower has a voltage gain just below one, yet it is everywhere. It can take a signal from a weak, high-impedance source and drive a heavy load without loading the source. In this lesson: Draw the emitter follower and explain its working.
Show it is voltage-series feedback with beta equals 1.
Calculate its voltage gain and input impedance.

body.en: In the *emitter follower* (common-collector amplifier) the input is applied to the base, the output is taken across $R_E$ at the emitter, and the collector is connected directly to $V_{CC}$, which is AC ground. The whole output voltage appears in series opposition with the input ($v_{be} = v_i - v_o$), so it is voltage-series negative feedback with $\beta = 1$. The emitter voltage follows the base voltage: the gain is slightly less than 1 and there is no phase reversal.

points.en: Av ≈ 1, output in phase with input

narration.en: In an emitter follower the output is taken at the emitter. All of it is fed back, so the gain is just below one and the output follows the input in phase.
narration.kn: ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಫಾಲೋವರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಎಮಿಟರ್‌ನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಿತವಾಗುವುದರಿಂದ (β = 1) ವರ್ಧನೆ ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಹಂತ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

text.en: High Zin, low Zout: a buffer

say.en: On the board: the emitter follower.

narration.en: The whole output across RE is fed back in series with the input (100% voltage-series feedback). So the output follows the input almost exactly, in phase, with Av = (1 + hfe)RE / (hie + (1 + hfe)RE), slightly below 1. The input impedance is high and the output impedance is low (hie = 1 kΩ, source 1 kΩ).
narration.kn: RE ಮೇಲಿನ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ನಿರ್ಗಮ ಒಳಹರಿವಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿರ್ಗಮ ಒಳಹರಿವನ್ನು ಅದೇ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, Av 1 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಒಳ ಪ್ರತಿಬಾಧೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಹೊರ ಪ್ರತಿಬಾಧೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

body.en: Using h-parameters, $A_v = (1+h_{fe})R_E/[h_{ie} + (1+h_{fe})R_E] \approx 1$, the current gain is $A_i \approx 1 + h_{fe}$, the input impedance $Z_{in} \approx h_{ie} + (1 + h_{fe})R_E$ is high, and the output impedance $Z_{out} \approx (R_s + h_{ie})/(1 + h_{fe})$ is low. It is therefore used as a buffer for impedance matching between a high-impedance source and a low-impedance load. Two *emitter followers* in cascade form a Darlington pair.

points.en: Used as a buffer / impedance matcher

narration.en: The emitter follower has unity voltage gain, high current gain, high input impedance and low output impedance, so it is used as a buffer.
narration.kn: ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಫಾಲೋವರ್‌ಗೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ವರ್ಧನೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವರ್ಧನೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧ ಇದೆ; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬಫರ್ ಆಗಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

problem.en: An emitter follower has hfe = 99, hie = 1 kΩ and RE = 2 kΩ. Find its voltage gain and input impedance.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An emitter follower has hfe = 99, hie = 1 kΩ and RE = 2 kΩ. Find its voltage gain and input impedance.

say.en: Let us work this out together. An emitter follower has hfe equals 99, hie equals 1 k ohms and RE equals 2 k ohms. Find its voltage gain and input impedance.
1 plus hfe equals 100, so 1 plus hfeRE equals 200 k ohms.
Av equals 200 over 1 plus 200 equals 0.995.
Zin equals 1 plus 200 equals 201 k ohms.
So the answer is Av is approximately 0.995, Zin is approximately 201 k ohms.

problem.en: For the same transistor, the source resistance is Rs = 1 kΩ. Estimate the output impedance.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. For the same transistor, the source resistance is Rs = 1 kΩ. Estimate the output impedance.

say.en: Let us work this out together. For the same transistor, the source resistance is Rs equals 1 k ohms. Estimate the output impedance.
Zout is approximately Rs plus hie/1 plus hfe equals 1 plus 1 k ohms/100.
Zout is approximately 0.02 k ohms equals 20 ohms.
So the answer is About 20 ohms.
